results.title: NuPlay: AI transformation, run on one self-improving platform | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hi Product Hunt, I'm hunting NuPlay today. Most enterprise AI projects follow the same arc: a promising pilot, a launch, and then slow decay. Policies change, products change, customers ask new questions, and the agent stays exactly as it was shipped. NuPlay is built around the opposite idea. It runs enterprise workflows in production and improves them after every run, with the agents, the systems they operate and the context they draw on in one platform. The platform comes together in five parts: NuPro is where you build the agents. You set behaviour, personality, speech, call handling, privacy and post-call analytics, then simulate the agent before you deploy it. Agents work across voice, chat, email and messaging, in support, sales, HR, vendor operations and marketing. NuStack makes [...] Anushtha Singh

My favourite part of this job has been learning to explain one idea simply: most AI agents are at their best on the day they ship, and NuPlay is built so they get better after that. Every run feeds back into the agent, so it keeps up as policies, products and customer questions change.  
  
About NuPlay AI: It runs enterprise-grade AI agents in production and improves them after every run.

Most AI projects follow the same arc: a promising pilot, a launch, then slow decay. The agent was trained on how the business looked on launch day, and everything after that becomes manual patching. NuPlay closes that gap. Each run is a signal: what worked, what didn’t, what’s changed. That learning goes straight back into the agent, so it gets sharper the more it works. [...] Subscribe

results.content:
"Software development is becoming more agentic." This is a good summary of what is happening right now. We are moving from AI that helps you write faster, to AI that can take over tasks (actions, use tools, make changes, run tests, and bring the work back for human review). That is a very different behavior.   
The article gives Cisco as an example. They used Codex for a big part of their AI Defense platform and reduced delivery time from several quarters to a few weeks.
